CMOS current-controlled ring oscillator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
II 0 iref PWL(0 20u 5u 20u 5.02u 40u 10u 40u 10.02u 80u 15u 80u)
.ic v(core)=.2
XDUT vdd 0 iref core out astra_073_cmos_current_controlled_ring_oscillator
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec p1 range 5e-8 2.5e-7 unit=s
* @spec p2 range 2.5e-8 1.4e-7 unit=s
* @spec p3 range 1.2e-8 8e-8 unit=s
* @spec ratio12 range 1.6 2.4 unit=dimensionless
* @spec ratio23 range 1.6 2.4 unit=dimensionless
* @spec high1 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec low1 range -0.02 0.1 unit=V
* @spec high3 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec low3 range -0.02 0.1 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 200p 15u
meas tran p1 TRIG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=10 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=11
meas tran p2 TRIG v(out) VAL=1.65 TD=6u RISE=1 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 TD=6u RISE=2
meas tran p3 TRIG v(out) VAL=1.65 TD=11u RISE=1 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 TD=11u RISE=2
let cratio12=0*time+p1/p2
let cratio23=0*time+p2/p3
meas tran ratio12 FIND cratio12 AT=14u
meas tran ratio23 FIND cratio23 AT=14u
meas tran high1 MAX v(out) FROM=1u TO=4u
meas tran low1 MIN v(out) FROM=1u TO=4u
meas tran high3 MAX v(out) FROM=11u TO=14u
meas tran low3 MIN v(out) FROM=11u TO=14u
write out.raw v(out) v(core) v(iref)
quit
.endc
.end
